title: Activity dashboard gets a usage UI refresh
summary:
A quiet maintenance day: clearer usage data, fresh ecosystem metrics, and audit automation wired in.

The activity dashboard’s usage interface was refreshed, making it easier to inspect how Pollinations infrastructure is being used without excavating the numbers by hand.

The daily app metrics update keeps the project’s view of its growing ecosystem current. The garden has been counted.

Credentials for the pollinations-audit GitHub App were added to repository secrets, supporting automated project oversight behind the scenes.
